subject: Your weekly student newsletter
summary: Events, opportunities and updates from across the Imperial community.
body: Hi Phuwin,
Here’s your weekly update from Imperial.
This week, take a look at upcoming campus events, student society activities, and opportunities to get involved across the College.
You can also check your course portal for next week’s timetable and any updates from your department.
Have a good week,
Imperial Student Communications

subject: Your package is out for delivery
body: Hi Phuwin,
Your package is out for delivery and is expected to arrive today.
Please check your delivery preferences if you won’t be home.
Thanks for shopping with us.
Amazon Delivery Team

subject: New episodes are waiting for you
summary: Your watchlist has been updated with new episodes.
body: Hey Phuwin,
Your watchlist has new episodes waiting for you.
Whether you’re catching up on your current favourites or looking for something new, there’s always another story to get into.
Grab a snack, get comfortable, and enjoy your next episode.
The Crunchyroll Team

subject: Your wishlist has a special offer
summary: A game on your wishlist is now on sale.
body: Hi Phuwin,
A game from your Steam wishlist is currently on sale.
If you’ve been waiting for the right time to add it to your library, now might be a good time to take another look.
Open Steam to browse your wishlist and discover more games.
Happy gaming,
The Steam Team

subject: Reminder: coursework submission deadline
summary: Please check your course portal for the upcoming deadline.
body: Hi Phuwin,
This is a reminder to review the submission deadline and requirements for your upcoming coursework.
Please check your course portal for the latest instructions and make sure you leave enough time to submit your work before the deadline.
If you have any questions, contact your module team.
Best wishes,
Imperial Course Administration

subject: We’ve received your parcel
summary: Your parcel is on its way.
body: Hi Phuwin,
We’ve received your parcel and it’s now moving through our delivery network.
We’ll send you another update when there is more information about its progress.
Thank you for using Royal Mail.
Royal Mail Team

subject: New chapters are available
summary: Catch up with the latest chapters from your favourites.
body: Hi Phuwin,
New chapters are available to read.
Your favourite series may have new pages waiting, so take a moment to catch up whenever you have time.
Thanks for reading with MANGA Plus.
MANGA Plus Team

subject: October games and updates
body: Hi Phuwin,
Here’s your monthly gaming update.
Discover selected games, recent updates, and highlights from the PlayStation community.
Check the PlayStation Store whenever you’re ready to see what’s new.
See you in game,
PlayStation Team

subject: Your Discover Weekly is ready
summary: A new playlist made for you is waiting.
body: Hey Phuwin,
Your Discover Weekly playlist is ready.
We’ve put together another collection of tracks for you to explore. You might find something new for your commute, your study sessions, or your late-night listening.
Open Spotify and give it a listen.
Happy listening,
Spotify

subject: Your weekly activity summary
summary: Here’s what’s been happening in your communities.
body: Hi Phuwin,
Here’s a quick look at activity across your communities this week.
Some of the manga and gaming servers you’re part of have new discussions and updates waiting for you.
Open Discord whenever you have time to catch up.
See you around,
Discord Team
